Shih Tian’s Final Portraits

Veteran Hong Kong actor Shih Tian is captured in two contrasting portraits: one in monochrome, where he gazes thoughtfully with round glasses and a neatly trimmed white beard, and another in color, where he beams in a tropical-patterned shirt. sources.description:
Shih Tin at Aces Go Places Event

Shih Tin, celebrated for his comedic roles and as a co-founder of Cinema City, addresses attendees at a promotional gathering. He holds a microphone and smiles broadly, dressed in a gray suit with a boutonnière pinned to his lapel.

Behind him, a vibrant poster for the 1982 Hong Kong action-comedy “Aces Go Places” displays the film’s English title alongside Chinese credits for Sam Hui, Karl Maka, Sylvia Chang, and Shih Tin. The poster’s dynamic artwork and bold typography underscore the movie’s playful spirit and ensemble cast.

Dean Sek on Stage

Dean Sek, celebrated for his memorable comedic performances in classic Hong Kong martial arts films, appears here in a relaxed setting.
